name: qrvai
description: International amateur radio assistant with RF calculations, propagation, operating guidance, worldwide hobby education and source-scoped regulatory intelligence. English and Greek in V1; national coverage varies.

interface.longDescription: QRVAI helps amateur radio enthusiasts worldwide with RF/antenna calculations, space weather, satellite passes, operating techniques, digital modes and hobby-first learning. A source-scoped regulatory research layer distinguishes ITU, regional recommendations and verified national rules; current official-source adapters cover selected Greece and US material only, not worldwide legal permissions. English and Greek are supported in V1. No transmitter control, guaranteed legal authorization or automatic licence-exam preparation.
defaultPrompt: @QRVAI How do I calculate feedline loss on 20 metres?
@QRVAI Explain solar Kp and how it affects HF propagation.
@QRVAI Teach me CW from scratch, without licence-exam material.
